text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training finished, I was walking 
with Sakura Chiyono O when we spotted Rice 
Shower looking distressed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That's so scary...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, what are you doing in a place 
like this?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I just went for a run to the 
shrine, but it seems I left my smartphone 
behind when taking a break..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's terrible! We have to go 
search for it right away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, shrines at night are pitch black 
and completely deserted, so it's kind of 
scary...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It certainly is daunting when you're all 
on your own, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...Understood! I'll go with you!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't just leave Rice Shower on her own, 
and I think having two of us will be a bit 
more reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Since we're already heading 
there, why don't we run? It'll double as 
training, killing two birds with one 
stone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, but if you run, 
won't you end up overworking yourself...?
choice_data_list: Make sure you come straight back, got it?
I'll come with you, so let's walk there
I'll come with you, so let's walk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, but if you run, 
won't you end up overworking yourself...?
choice_data_list: Make sure you come straight back, got it?
I'll come with you, so let's walk there
I'll come with you, so let's walk.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll hurry on over so you don't have 
to worry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...When we enter the shrine, would it be 
all right if we held hands...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, actually, I'm not very good with 
ghosts and stuff either, so I would really 
appreciate that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, scared as they were, the two of 
them ran toward the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh, you too, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Let's all cool down together after 
exercising

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! With three of us, it won't 
be scary at all anymore—in fact, it sounds 
like a fun walk!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us headed to the 
shrine while chatting and laughing, and 
safely found the smartphone.
